basic_abilities.desc_zh: 该机器人能够对其防御、进攻和电力系统进行升级。
随着时间的推移造成能量伤害。
随着时间的推移，减去一定百分比的对手力量。
修复随着时间的推移失去的生命值。

game_abilities.title_en: Each time Wheeljack Transforms he begins to Construct a random Upgrade for {{var_1}}. [Max 3 Upgrades]
game_abilities.desc_zh: 每次千斤顶变形时，他都会开始为 {{var_1}} 构建随机升级。 [最多3次升级]

game_abilities.title_en: If Wheeljack Is struck by a Critical Melee Hit while Constructing, the Construction Fails and the Upgrade is lost.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 如果千斤顶在建造时被致命的近战攻击击中，建造就会失败并且升级也会丢失。

game_abilities.title_en: If Wheeljack is hit with a critical heavy attack or a critical special attack, the Upgrade is destroyed and the upgrade is lost.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 如果千斤顶受到严重重击或严重特殊技，升级就会被破坏并且升级会丢失。

game_abilities.title_en: Defensive Upgrade: {{var_2}} Damage Resistance and increases to the chance Special Attacks will inflict Stun by {{var_3}}.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 防御升级：{{var_2}} 伤害抗性并增加特殊技造成 {{var_3}} 眩晕的几率。

game_abilities.title_en: Offensive Upgrade: {{var_4}} Attack Rating and increases the chance Special Attacks will inflict Shock by {{var_5}}.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 进攻升级：{{var_4}} 攻击评级并增加特殊技造成 {{var_5}} 触电的几率。

game_abilities.title_en: Power Upgrade: {{var_6}} Power Rate and increases the chance Special Attacks will inflict Power Leak by {{var_7}}.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 力量升级：{{var_6}} 力量速率并增加特殊技造成 {{var_7}} 力量泄漏的几率。

game_abilities.title_en: If Wheeljack is struck by a Melee Critical Hit from a Special or Heavy Attack the newest Upgrade constructed will be removed.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 如果千斤顶被特殊技或重击的近战暴击击中，则构建的最新升级将被删除。

game_abilities.title_en: Success: If Wheeljack Constructs 3 of the same Upgrade type he randomly Repairs between {{var_8}} of Max Health.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 成功：如果千斤顶建造了 3 个相同的升级类型，他会在最大生命值的 {{var_8}} 之间随机修复。
